definitions.full: H2716. chere [ חֶרֶא , or חֲרִי ] noun [masculine] dung (Late Hebrew חרא ( י ), id. ; Aramaic id. ; Mandean חרא (on this and cognate languages in General see Nö M 56 ); Arabic id. , whence verb of act, and noun of place; Amharic (Di Lex. Aeth. 88 )) — plural suffix חַרְאֵיהֶם Isa 36:12 Kt (Qr צוֺאָתָם ); || 2Kin 18:27 has חֲרִיהֶם (see singular חרי 6:25 ; Qr as above); יוֺנִים חֲרִי dove's dung 6:25 Kt (Qr דִּבִיוֺנִים ); see, further, Gei Urschrift, 409 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused (and vulgar) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels;
